description: The Bambu Lab H2D is an enclosed FDM 3D printer with two nozzles. It builds parts layer by layer from plastic filament, so you can make prototypes, enclosures, fixtures and functional parts. With two nozzles, one print can combine two colours or materials, such as rigid and flexible plastic or a separate support material. Its heated chamber helps when printing engineering plastics like ABS, PC, nylon and fibre-filled filaments.
materials: Carbon/glass fibre reinforced PLA, PETG, PA, PET, PC, ABS, ASA
ppeRequired: Safety glasses when removing parts or support material
Heat-resistant gloves when handling the hot nozzle or bed
useRestrictions: Only trained users may run the printer, and the optional laser and cutting modules need separate staff authorisation and the laser-safety enclosure.
